mapper.select: SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT prj_id FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')
mapper.select: WITH relevant AS ( SELECT dev_id FROM cst.mth_cst WHERE cst_ym=#{month} UNION SELECT a.dev_id FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE UNION SELECT dev_id FROM cst.drct_expns WHERE expns_ym=#{month} AND dev_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT d.dev_id,coalesce(s.emp_se_cd,d.emp_se_cd) AS emp_se_cd, coalesce(s.duty_se_cd,d.duty_se_cd) AS duty_se_cd,s.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM relevant r JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=r.dev_id LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst s ON s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=#{month} ORDER BY d.dev_id

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,a.prj_id,m.mm_qty,a.asgn_stts_cd,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd, a.asgn_se_cd,u.bill_untprc_amt,tk.tk_sls_amt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= greatest(to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM'),a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(t.aloc_amt)::bigint AS tk_sls_amt FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l JOIN prj.tk_aloc_mth t ON t.aloc_line_id=l.aloc_line_id AND t.aloc_ym=#{month} WHERE l.prj_id=a.prj_id AND l.dev_id=a.dev_id AND l.line_ty_cd='PERSON' AND l.aloc_stg_cd=(SELECT x.aloc_stg_cd FROM prj.tk_aloc_line x WHERE x.prj_id=a.prj_id ORDER BY CASE x.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1) ) tk ON true WHERE ORDER BY a.asgn_id
SELECT e.expns_id,e.dev_id,e.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,e.expns_amt FROM cst.drct_expns e LEFT JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=e.prj_id WHERE e.expns_ym=#{month} ORDER BY e.expns_id

SELECT month FROM ( SELECT m.work_ym AS month FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' UNION SELECT s.cst_ym FROM cst.mth_cst s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.dev_id=s.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(s.cst_ym,'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >=to_date(s.cst_ym,'YYYY-MM')) UNION SELECT e.expns_ym FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.prj_id=#{projectId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.dev_id=e.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(e.expns_ym,'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >=to_date(e.expns_ym,'YYYY-MM')) UNION SELECT cst_ym FROM cst.cst_aloc WHERE prj_id=#{projectId} ) months WHERE month <= #{month} ORDER BY month
